caption:
$3.49 an hour: the median on-demand price of one NVIDIA H100 GPU today.

That is up from a $1.95 low in October 2025, but far below the $8 median of mid-2023. The spread between the cheapest and the most expensive H100 listing is still almost 10x, so where you rent matters more than when.

Also this week: Nvidia's Vera Rubin went generally available on Oracle Cloud. No public hourly price yet.

Data: Coloprice GPU Rental Price Index, 16 Oct 2026. News: DCD, 27 Oct 2026. All sources on the last slide.
